purpose: Collect the clean full-push calibration required to describe circuit D before any Sebring LICO outcome is observed or any zero-LICO-shot prediction is frozen.

sessions.objective: Obtain five clean consecutive full-push laps for Sebring braking, approach-speed, acceleration and local fuel/time references.
sessions.lico_variation_guidance: No intentional LICO, lift-and-coast or fuel-saving action. Normal throttle modulation required to drive corners is not LICO.
sessions.execution_quality_notes: Retain every recorded lap. Mark impacts, off-tracks, missed braking points, spins, traffic-like interruptions and abnormal slowdowns by lap and corner; use zone-level exclusions when an otherwise useful lap has one localized error.
sessions.notes: Start with 55 L, Oreca 07 LMP2, full 12-hour layout, constant weather, zero tire wear and one unchanged setup. Drive five scored laps; up to two replacement laps are allowed, for seven scored laps maximum, if an error occurs. No live cue runner or beep is used.
